description: Acceptance manifest: the CANONICAL requirement set per PR — the source of the criteria + required-gates the WP-12B validator reconciles a review against, supplied as TrustedInputs, NOT taken from the review artifact. A reviewer cannot invent, drop, or renumber criteria: the set here must be enumerated completely. Criterion text is mirrored from the governing (owner-review-pending, not-yet-ratified) spec section named in `spec`, and both must agree on `review_model`. STATUS is owner-review-pending: this is the builder's PROPOSED bar; it becomes the ratified bar when the owner approves this PR's protected-surface change (it lives under assurance/contract/ in protected-surface.txt, so a builder cannot later edit it without owner review). `required_gates` are logical keys the CI merge-gate binds to REAL check conclusions (github needs.*.result); the validator requires each to be a real 'success' for APPROVE.
